text:
Emma L: Quick sync from the Orchid Health postmortem — root cause was a peering flap + on-prem firewall rule mismatch that caused tenant isolation for ~22m. We captured timeline in the doc but need clear owners + short timelines for follow-ups.

Devin R: noted. I can take the VPC peering policy audit and add automated checks. Will need access to the peering logs from the provider (cloudops).

SRE Bot: Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2337001234 (postmortem + timeline). Attachments: peering-flap.pcap, net-trace.log

Emma L: Action items I want to track in this thread. Short and actionable.

Mike T: I'll own the on-prem checklist and the firewall rule template we give to customers. Plan: update playbook, add validation script, ship to private-cust repo. ETA end of next week (2026-04-02).

Anya K: I'll add integration tests to our pre-deploy harness so future peering configs are validated in CI. Need to coordinate with Devin for test cases. ETA: 2 weeks.

Devin R: Proposed AI tickets: 
- AI-4578: Add peering-state and bgp-route validation to infra healthchecks (owner: Devin R, due: 2026-03-31)
- AI-4579: Add automated fallback policy when peering flaps exceed 3m (owner: Emma L, due: 2026-04-07)

Emma L: assigning AI-4579 to me for the routing fallback policy config. I'll draft the policy and follow up with SRE for canary.

Mike T: AI-4580: Firewall rule template + validation script for on-prem customers (owner: Mike T, due: 2026-04-02)

Anya K: AI-4581: CI integration tests for peering/config validation (owner: Anya K, due: 2026-04-08)

Sarah P: I'll handle customer comms and update the remediation timeline we sent to Orchid Health. Draft ready by EOD tomorrow.

Emma L: Also want a recurring check to spot pattern: several recent dedicated customers hit peering flaps + on-prem misconfigs. Can we get a weekly report?

Devin R: I can add a weekly peering-flap KPI email (counts, affected tenants, avg downtime) from our metrics pipeline. Will prototype next week.

SRE Bot: Reminder: please tag PRs with incident-id: 2337001234 and use label: postmortem-fix

Mike T: Quick note on testing: for on-prem, two common failures — inverted CIDR ACL and asymmetric NAT. I'll add explicit test vectors.

Anya K: Example validation snippet I'll add to CI: 
```bash
# verify peer BGP session and route propagation
cloudctl peering get --peer-id $PEER | jq .state
ip route show table 42 | grep $CUSTOMER_PREFIX
```

Emma L: Good. Let's keep this light: owners + 1-sentence acceptance criteria + due dates. I'll consolidate into the incident doc and create the AI tickets in JIRA.

Devin R: Ping me if you need the exact peering log slices. I'll redact customer IPs and drop into the doc.

Sarah P: Customer OK with remediation plan, they asked for ETA on the playbook update. I'll give them 2026-04-02 for the firewall template and 2026-04-08 for CI tests.

Emma L: Final checklist for this thread before I create the tickets:
- [x] Owner assignments (Devin, Mike, Anya, Sarah, Emma)
- [ ] JIRA tickets created (I'll create and post links here)
- [ ] Weekly KPI report prototype (Devin)
- [ ] PRs reference incident-id 2337001234

Mike T: I'll start a draft PR today for the firewall template (WIP).

Anya K: I'll open a draft branch with the CI tests and add demo CI run logs.

SRE Bot: Deploy bot: scheduled canary for fallback policy requires a canary window — please request via #release-war-room when ready.

Emma L: Thanks all — I'll create the JIRA tickets and post links here shortly. If anything slips, tag me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
